column1: STANDARD CONTRACTOR TERMS, CONDITIONS & WORKMANSHIP WARRANTY

column2: The contractor agrees to perform the scope of work specified in the Client Proposal. The pricing stated in this document is valid for 30 calendar days from the date of issuance. Any work not explicitly listed is excluded.

Payments shall be made according to the agreed milestone payment schedule: 20% mobilization deposit upon signing, milestone progress invoices during construction, and final payment upon completion of punchlist items.
Any alteration or deviation from the original specifications involving extra costs or schedule extensions will be executed only upon a written Change Order signed by both Owner and Contractor.
The owner agrees to provide reasonable access to the property during standard working hours (7:00 AM - 5:00 PM) and make water and electricity available for construction purposes without charge.
Novality Construction & Design LLC provides a 1-year limited workmanship warranty on all installations. Standard manufacturer warranties apply to all installed equipment and material fixtures.
The contractor shall maintain general liability and workers' compensation insurance throughout the project duration and hold valid municipal trade licenses.
The contractor is not responsible for project delays caused by severe weather, material vendor backorders, strikes, or municipal permitting delays beyond contractor control.
